entries.name: Initiate
entries.description: A gentler descent for learning the Abyss. Fewer foes, fewer elites, extra healing and an extra salve to start. Death is still permanent.

entries.name: Exile
entries.description: The standard descent: the balance every earlier version shipped with.

entries.name: Adversary
entries.description: More foes arrive in tighter squads and one more elite walks each deeper floor. Loot and starting kit are unchanged.

entries.name: Sovereign
entries.description: The Abyss presses. Larger, tighter squads, an extra elite, scarcer healing and one fewer starting salve. Plan routes and spend carefully.
